title: Eritrea Deploys Tanks and Heavy Weaponry Into Northern Tigray
detail: Eritrean military assets, including tanks and heavy weaponry, moved into northern Ethiopia's Tigray region, according to Ethiopian government-aligned reporting. The deployment followed the August 3 Zalambesa flag incident and was cast by Addis Ababa as further evidence that Asmara is abandoning restraint and actively backing TPLF hardliners under the alleged 'Tsimdo' coordination, even as Ethiopian officials said they were maintaining diplomatic restraint rather than responding militarily.

media.caption: Horn Review analysis of Eritrea's military escalation toward Tigray

confidenceReason: Sourced from an Ethiopian government outlet and an allied regional think tank; independent verification of tank movements has not been reported by neutral or Eritrean sources.
